name: Roadhouse Finder
description: An all new app that helps you quickly discover restaurants, gas stations, cafés, and more on German highways.

images.title: Detailed map
images.description: Instantly view all roadhouses across Germany on an interactive map, complete with markers for easy navigation and discovery.

images.title: Searchable
images.description: Quickly find specific roadhouses or services with the built-in search function — no more endless scrolling or guessing.

images.title: Categorized
images.description: Browse roadhouses by highway to narrow down your search and plan your stops with precision based on your route.

introduction: Roadhouse Finder is my all new app made for German highways. The idea: There are quite many roadhouses located at several highways with all kinds of restaurants, gas stations, cafés and more. But one thing is missing: knowing whats where. You may find a desired café on Maps, but that mostly just works for a specific search. Roadhouse Finder fixes exactly that problem. It's a map focussed on the German roadhouses and lets you find what you're looking for quickly.
launchInfo:
At the moment, the progress on the app is slower than anticipated. 
 We currently aim to release in Fall 2026, more on that in the future.
subscriptionInfo: Details regarding the subscription are following at a later point of time.

name: Trick Counting
description: No more need for pen and paper to play Trick Counting

images.title: Easy to use
images.description: Effortlessly track each round of your game with a clean interface and intuitive flow — no learning curve needed.

images.title: Fully customizable
images.description: Add players, update scores, and control each round the way you play — flexibility built into every detail.

images.title: Statistics
images.description: View detailed summaries and visual charts to see who’s winning and how the game evolved over time.

introduction: Trick Counting - Point Tracker is a digital companion designed to streamline the scoring process for the card game Trick Counting. Eliminating the need for paper and pencil, the app allows you to input the predictions and results for each round directly on your device. At the game's conclusion, it provides a comprehensive summary, detailing each player's placements and round-by-round performance.
launchInfo: Right now on the iOS App Store!
subscriptionInfo: This app is useable with a one-time purchase and will always be, enjoy! Thank you to everybody who purchased the app for supporting me!! I appreciate it very much!

name: HLG-KAIFU App
subheadline: The app for HLG and KaiFU in Hamburg, Germany
description: The app for HLG and KaiFU in Hamburg, Germany
introduction: HLG-KAIFU App is a digital companion for everything regarding high school at HLG or KaiFU. Starting with the latest news from the websites to stay informed. Continuing with calculators for both school certificates as well as your high school diploma. Furthermore, the app offers a homework tracker so you won't forget any homework as it even reminds you in advance.
launchInfo:
The app was available on the App Store between August 2021 and December 2024.
However, due to lack of maintenance, the app was flagged to be taken down by Apple. Over the years, our focus has shifted and therefor we have decided to not update the app.

A big thank you to everybody, who used the app over the years! We hope it helped you during your time at school.
For everybody who is interested in alternatives, I can highly recommend my other app University Wizard
